canDo: Organise written and spoken output faster, and cut down on “I know it but can’t get it out”.
review: Review your personal high-frequency chunks and connectors.
input: A little input, just to spark opinions.
output: 2 writing outlines + 1 full essay; 3 speaking rounds.
checkpoint: Planning stage ≤10 minutes; can point out pauses in speaking and re-record.
challenge: Today’s challenge: an “output speed-up” session. Pick any social topic from RFI’s « Journal en français facile »; in a timed 2 minutes, outline position – 2 arguments – 1 example – 1 concession; then write the 160 words in 20 minutes and record 3 minutes of speaking from the same outline. Look up 3 expressions you wanted to say but couldn’t, in writing or speaking, and add them to your personal chunk list.
